reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) confirms the baseline properties of HfMoTaTiZr and shows that HfMoNbTiZr is a studied composition, but it does not provide density data for either alloy, nor does it directly compare the high-temperature strength of HfMoNbTiZr to HfMoTaTiZr to support the claim of preserved performance. The premise that Nb substitution reduces density relies on general knowledge, not cited evidence.
premises: Nb and Ta are similarly refractory and will maintain BCC structure and high-temperature strengthening
Substituting Ta with Nb reduces density because Nb is lighter than Ta
HfMoNbTiZr (Ta-free) retains high strength at room temperature and ~1000 °C comparable to HfMoTaTiZr
HfMoTaTiZr has a density of ~10.21 g/cm³ and high strength at room and elevated temperatures
